messages:
sasha: following the RFC thread, dropping a lightweight attenuation playbook for compat shims. want quick feedback.
maya: skimmed, looks practical. paste the checklist?
sasha: 1) owner declared (platform/runtime/engine) 2) telemetry events: compat.attenuate.install/decision/revert 3) canary smoke + token-diff check 4) rollback thresholds (error_pct, latency_delta, divergence_pct) 5) tenant opt-in toggles + global kill switch 6) header contract X-RW-Attenuate: probe|on|off 7) CI header-pass test 8) cache-control no-store when active
liam: add a required_telemetry flag so we don't ship without events wired.
anna: recommend schema-drift probe: sample 100 responses, validate fields+types, trigger if >0.5% mismatches.
zayd: ops asks for an alerting route and an automatic audit dump on revert. also want shim_version label in metrics.
maya: and use a metrics tag compat_shim=true so SLO dashboards can filter.
sasha: sample UI toggle config: {"toggle":"attenuate_remove_field_v1","rollback":{"error_pct":1.0,"p95_latency_ms_delta":100,"divergence_pct":3.0},"window_minutes":15,"required_telemetry":true}
liam: CI test: send req with X-RW-Attenuate: probe through edge+proxy -> assert header present at origin and response includes X-RW-Attenuate-Applied: shim_v1.
anna: i'll take the smoke harness and drift checks.
maya: i'll draft dashboards and queries.
zayd: ops will own failover script and alert channel.
sasha: I'll update the RFC appendix with this playbook and add the telemetry schema. leaving open for 24h for extra comments. :eyes:
